reason: A post-v40 audit of the v37 training target showed that the compact map predicts exact complete-block output minus frozen trained-mixed complete-block output from the exact block-input hidden state. It is a layer-output corrector, not a per-weight LoRA and must not be attached to an individual linear matmul.

v37_preregistration.fit_target: complete trained-mixed block output versus exact BF16 block output

original_v40_wording_correction.superseded_next_stage_phrase: attach the node at llama.cpp build_lora_mm
original_v40_wording_correction.correct_next_stage: load one compact payload per selected layer and apply the proven binary graph node after the selected complete block as candidate_block_output + correction(saved_block_input)

correct_graph_semantics.saved_input: the exact hidden-state tensor entering the selected transformer block
correct_graph_semantics.base_output: the complete output tensor produced by the exact frozen trained CQ3-MLP plus AFF3-attention candidate block
correct_graph_semantics.result: base_output + bias_FP16 + ((saved_input_FP32 @ left_INT8) * left_scale_FP16 * right_scale_FP16) @ right_INT8
correct_graph_semantics.placement: after the full candidate block and before the next block consumes its hidden state
